_comment: Example project spec for bootstrap-emit-commands.sh (DR-035). The skill assembles this from the Q&A intake + the captured App IDs, then renders the VM-side handoff. This worked example mirrors use-cases/scientific-paper-fleet.md (icsoc-2026).
_comment_repo_provenance: Per-agent `repo_provenance` (optional, default "template") controls the emitted VM step: "template" -> `git clone` the GitHub repo into deploy_path; "overleaf-mirror" (or "mirror") -> the deploy_path dir ALREADY EXISTS (e.g. an Overleaf-backed paper repo) and the GitHub repo is an empty mirror target, so the handoff does `git remote add github ... && git push -u github HEAD` instead of cloning.
